raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What

Adds a MI35x nightly accuracy gate for MiniMax-M3.1-Flash that runs the cookbook's MI355X / Flash / MXFP4 / Low-Latency / single-node / DSpark cell:

- Test: `test/registered/amd/accuracy/mi35x/test_minimax_m31_flash_mxfp4_eval_mi35x.py`
- Suite: `nightly-amd-4-gpu-mi35x-minimax-m31-flash-mxfp4`
- Job: `nightly-4-gpu-mi35x-minimax-m31-flash-mxfp4` on `linux-mi35x-gpu-8` (TP4), 5400 s per-file cap

The server uses the cookbook command unchanged: `amd/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Quark-MXFP4`, `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, TP4, DSpark with block verification and the draft bundled in the checkpoint, breakable prefill graphs, the aiter FP8 GEMM backend, and the minimax-m3 parsers. GSM8K runs through sgl-eval on the full split (1319 questions, 8192 max tokens, temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95) with a 0.93 threshold. These match the H200 and B300 M3.1 nightlies in #46627, so all three gates read the same way.

## Depends on

- #46693 (with the kernel PRs #46690, #46691, #46692), which adds the gfx950 M3.1 path. On `main` today the Quark checkpoint has no ROCm path for DSpark or the MXFP4 experts.
- #46587, which lets `amd/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Quark-MXFP4` start with shared-experts fusion left on, as in the cookbook command. Without it the server fails at weight load.

This PR stays in draft until those land.

## Notes for the reviewer

- **Threshold:** 0.93, as in the NVIDIA M3.1 nightlies. This checkpoint measured 0.9575 on rocm720 (below).
- **DSpark accept length** is gated at 3.8, also as on B300. It measured 4.21 on rocm720.
- **rocm10:** at #46693's 9ed330c94c the server hung after 71 of 1319 questions. At 6719205cf4 rocm10 passes (below). That head drops the ROCm 7.2-tuned hipBLASLt rows on other ROCm versions, among other changes; I haven't isolated which commit fixed the hang.
- Only the MXFP4 cell is covered. The NVFP4 checkpoint on MI355X runs the same command and could be added as a second class on the same job later.

## Test plan

Run on a branch with `main` at ec3365de18 plus #46693 and #46587 merged in, and this test (`michael/minimax-m31-mxfp4-validate`). #46587 conflicts with #46693 in `quark.py`; the branch keeps both changes and enables #46587's E8M0 scale decode only when #46693's MXFP8 path is off.

| ROCm | Result | GSM8K | Accept length | Test time | Run |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| rocm720, #46693 at 9ed330c94c | pass | 0.9575 | 4.21 | 765 s | [job](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40637706513/job/122648395479) |
| rocm10, #46693 at 9ed330c94c | hang after 71/1319 | - | - | 5400 s (cap) | [job](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40637702292/job/122654438267) |
| rocm10, #46693 at 6719205cf4 | pass | 0.9553 | 4.14 | 705 s | [job](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40741702372/job/123004732179) |

The first rocm10 attempt failed while downloading the checkpoint: the rocm720 job, on another runner sharing the model cache, deleted the in-progress download. That is a CI cache race, not this test.

- The workflow parses with PyYAML, and the new job is in the `job_select` options and in `check-all-jobs.needs`.
- The CI registry parser picks up the file under the new suite. The file compiles and passes black and isort.

@@ -103,6 +103,8 @@ on:
           - nightly-4-gpu-mi35x-minimax-m3
           # 4-GPU MiniMax-M3 MXFP4 (MI35x)
           - nightly-4-gpu-mi35x-minimax-m3-mxfp4
+          # 4-GPU MiniMax-M3.1-Flash MXFP4 + DSpark (MI35x)
+          - nightly-4-gpu-mi35x-minimax-m31-flash-mxfp4
           # 8-GPU MiniMax-M2.7 (MI30x only)
           - nightly-8-gpu-minimax-m27
           # Diffusion (MI30x)
@@ -2283,6 +2285,46 @@ jobs:
           echo "$(<github_summary.md )" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY || true
           exit ${TEST_EXIT_CODE:-0}
 
+  # ==============================================================================
+  # 4-GPU MiniMax-M3.1-Flash MXFP4 + DSpark (MI35x)
+  # ==============================================================================
+
+  nightly-4-gpu-mi35x-minimax-m31-flash-mxfp4:
+    name: ${{ format('nightly-4-gpu-mi35x-minimax-m31-flash-mxfp4 ({0}, linux-mi35x-gpu-8)', matrix.rocm_version) }}
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      matrix:
+        rocm_version: ${{ fromJson(inputs.rocm_version && inputs.rocm_version != 'all' && format('["{0}"]', inputs.rocm_version) || '["rocm10", "rocm724", "rocm720"]') }}
+    if: (github.repository == 'sgl-project/sglang' || github.event_name == 'pull_request') && (!(inputs.job_filter || inputs.job_select) || (inputs.job_filter || inputs.job_select) == 'all' || contains(format(',{0},', inputs.job_filter || inputs.job_select), ',nightly-4-gpu-mi35x-minimax-m31-flash-mxfp4,'))
+    runs-on: linux-mi35x-gpu-8
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout code
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}
+
+      - name: Ensure VRAM is clear
+        run: bash scripts/ci/amd/ensure_vram_clear.sh rocm
+
+      - name: Setup docker (${{ matrix.rocm_version }})
+        run: |
+          touch github_summary.md
+          bash scripts/ci/amd/amd_ci_start_container.sh --rocm-version ${{ matrix.rocm_version }}
+        env:
+          GITHUB_WORKSPACE: ${{ github.workspace }}
+          ENABLE_CACHE_HOST: "1"
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: bash scripts/ci/amd/amd_ci_install_dependency.sh --skip-test-time-deps
+
+      - name: Accuracy Test MI35x ROCm (4-GPU MiniMax-M3.1-Flash MXFP4 + DSpark)
+        timeout-minutes: 120
+        run: |
+          > github_summary.md
+          bash scripts/ci/amd/amd_ci_exec.sh -w /sglang-checkout/test             -e SGLANG_USE_AITER=1             -e GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY="/sglang-checkout/github_summary.md"             python3 run_suite.py --hw amd --suite nightly-amd-4-gpu-mi35x-minimax-m31-flash-mxfp4 --nightly --timeout-per-file 5400 ${{ (github.event_name == 'schedule' || inputs.continue_on_error) && '--continue-on-error' || '' }} || TEST_EXIT_CODE=$?
+          echo "$(<github_summary.md )" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY || true
+          exit ${TEST_EXIT_CODE:-0}
+
   # ==============================================================================
   # 8-GPU MiniMax-M2.7 (MI30x only)
   # ==============================================================================
@@ -2456,6 +2498,8 @@ jobs:
       - nightly-4-gpu-mi35x-minimax-m3
       # 4-GPU MiniMax-M3 MXFP4 (MI35x)
       - nightly-4-gpu-mi35x-minimax-m3-mxfp4
+      # 4-GPU MiniMax-M3.1-Flash MXFP4 + DSpark (MI35x)
+      - nightly-4-gpu-mi35x-minimax-m31-flash-mxfp4
       # 8-GPU MiniMax-M2.7 (MI30x only)
       - nightly-8-gpu-minimax-m27
       # Diffusion (MI30x)

@@ -0,0 +1,73 @@
+"""MiniMax-M3.1-Flash Quark MXFP4 on the MI355X Low-Latency recipe, with DSpark.
+
+Runs the cookbook's MI355X / Flash / MXFP4 / Low-Latency / single-node / DSpark
+cell as published: AMD's Quark MXFP4 export at TP4 on four of the runner's
+eight GPUs, with the DSpark draft the checkpoint ships in its ``dspark/``
+subfolder. It covers the gfx950 M3.1 path end to end: the MXFP4 routed experts
+on AITER, the FP8 attention and dense GEMMs on AITER, the sparse attention
+kernels, and DSpark verify.
+
+GSM8K settings and the 0.93 threshold match the H200 and B300 M3.1 nightlies,
+so the three gates read the same way.
+
+Registry: nightly-amd-4-gpu-mi35x-minimax-m31-flash-mxfp4 suite
+"""
+
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.kits.eval_accuracy_kit import GSM8KMixin
+from sglang.test.server_fixtures.default_fixture import DefaultServerBase
+
+register_amd_ci(
+    est_time=1800,
+    suite="nightly-amd-4-gpu-mi35x-minimax-m31-flash-mxfp4",
+    nightly=True,
+)
+
+
+class TestMiniMaxM31FlashMXFP4MI35x(GSM8KMixin, DefaultServerBase):
+    model = "amd/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Quark-MXFP4"
+    # Covers a cold-cache download of the checkpoint plus weight load.
+    timeout = 3600
+    server_env = {"SGLANG_USE_AITER": "1"}
+    other_args = [
+        "--trust-remote-code",
+        "--reasoning-parser",
+        "minimax-m3",
+        "--tool-call-parser",
+        "minimax-m3",
+        "--tp",
+        "4",
+        "--speculative-algorithm",
+        "DSPARK",
+        "--speculative-use-block-verification",
+        "--cuda-graph-backend-prefill",
+        "breakable",
+        "--fp8-gemm-backend",
+        "aiter",
+        "--chunked-prefill-size",
+        "32768",
+        "--max-running-requests",
+        "128",
+        "--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode",
+        "128",
+        "--mem-fraction-static",
+        "0.8",
+        "--tokenizer-worker-num",
+        "8",
+    ]
+
+    gsm8k_backend = "sgl_eval"
+    gsm8k_num_examples = 1319
+    gsm8k_num_threads = 64
+    gsm8k_max_tokens = 8192
+    gsm8k_temperature = 1.0
+    gsm8k_top_p = 0.95
+    # Measured 0.9575 and accept length 4.21 on 4x MI355X (rocm720).
+    gsm8k_score_threshold = 0.93
+    gsm8k_accept_length_thres = 3.8
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
